lifecycle_contract.output_bound: nine-byte block header plus max(vendor compressBound, input bytes)
lifecycle_contract.return_length: actual block bytes; vendor zero return is not a compressed stream
lifecycle_contract.error_codes: stable tscb_status_v1 including UNSUPPORTED and DST_TOO_SMALL
lifecycle_contract.finalize: required, emits zero bytes, repeated call rejected
lifecycle_contract.reset: new context per independent repetition; C ABI reset clears counters

stream_components.descriptor: 12-byte prefix plus canonical JSON describing buffers and logical type
stream_components.block_header: one mode byte and eight-byte little-endian exact decoded length
stream_components.payload: vendor compressed bytes, one RLE symbol or exact raw bytes
stream_components.accounting: all serialized bytes charged once; no external side information

known_limitations: Value byte view only; source entropy library has no timestamp semantics.
Huff0 supports at most 128 KiB per native block; current FSE adapter shares this conservative bound.
Raw/RLE fallback is a distinct path recorded in the serialized mode byte; native API timing is supplemental and may be zero for fallback.
Single-block object only; streaming, arbitrary segmentation and dictionary sharing are not registered.
The benchmark's fastest-only timing loop is not reused; the project applies its formal repetition policy.
